meta.name: dotnet-run-file
meta.description: Run script-like CSharp programs using dotnet run file.cs. Use this skill when users want to execute CSharp code directly, write one-liner scripts via stdin, or learn about run file directives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要快速执行C#代码片段
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly execute C# code snippets

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能直接运行 C# 代码，无需创建项目文件。它可以通过 `dotnet run file.cs` 执行脚本式程序，也能接收 stdin 输入运行单行或多行代码，并支持使用指令（如 #:package）添加包或转换项目。
howto.when: 当用户想快速执行 C# 代码、编写单行脚本、学习 run file 指令或创建可执行脚本时触发。

say.note: Claude 通过 stdin 执行 C# 代码并返回结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can directly run C# code without creating project files. It executes script-like programs via `dotnet run file.cs`, accepts stdin input for one-liners or multi-line scripts, and supports directives like #:package to add packages or convert run files to projects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users want to quickly execute C# code, write one-liner scripts, learn about run file directives, or create executable shell scripts.

say_en.note: Claude executes the file using dotnet run file.cs.
Claude runs C# code via stdin and returns the result.
